# nav-progress — correction to deliverable -2

The browser screenshots in `scratch/nav-progress-*.png` (11:57–12:00) were taken on a **pre-rebase** build: nav-progress worktree at base `0aebeb1a5` plus the then-uncommitted diff (the same changes 574d871ca later made), built 11:55–11:56 and served on :3108. They predate the rebase onto `e37b1ea0d`, strip-067 and `819b43229`, so the page around the bar (question button, green header, alert toast) is older main, not `574d871ca`. The landed head's build is `H6HI76hQQhvLuy720tKTm` (fft run, 16:01). The reviewer (quokka) is producing the independent proof on that build; credit that, not these images.
